title: Split the four oversized source files into submodules, mechanically, one file per slice
outcome: No source file exceeds ~4k lines; every public path (crate::storage::SqliteStore, crate::work_service::LocalWorkService, crate::verbs::AgentVerbs) is unchanged; behavior, signatures, and tests are byte-for-byte the same code in new places

completion.summary: All four oversized files split mechanically, one file per slice, each landed after a matched freeze fingerprint, function/test/public-item (and DDL) set comparison, gates in a separate target directory, and a review pair: storage/work.rs 23.5k → 8 modules (864d36c), work_service.rs 13.3k → 8 (63fbb2f), storage.rs 19.1k → 9 (c3233bb), verbs.rs 5.4k → 4 + mirrored tests (7aede1f). Every source file is now below 4,000 lines; crate::storage::SqliteStore, crate::work_service::LocalWorkService, and crate::verbs::AgentVerbs paths are unchanged; behavior identical.
